name: Noir Detective
desc: Trench-coated detective under a hard cone of light, fedora brim shadowing his eyes, cigarette ember and smoke ribbon rising through rain, shifting weight as he leans, scans and walks.

density.doc: rain streak count in the beam

pose.doc: pose — lean auto-cycles lean/scan/walk over 32 beats

style.doc: aesthetic: chiaroscuro form-from-light / neon rim-lit / x-ray wireframe schematic / pale chalk-on-slate

act.doc: multi-minute program: stakeout = lean & scan, chase = walking, reveal = slow turn into the light
